WITH ArticleMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        catlabel AS article_category,
        -- Calculate ARS using the provided formula
        (readsec * LN(wordlen)) / 
        CASE 
            WHEN difflevel = 'Basic' THEN 1
            WHEN difflevel = 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
            WHEN difflevel = 'Advanced' THEN 2
            ELSE 1.2 
        END AS readability_score,
        -- Extract engagement rate from JSON
        (engagement_metrics->>'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate,
        difflevel AS complexity_level
    FROM 
        articles
),
ComplexityCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        complexity_level, 
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        complexity_level
),
AverageMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
),
CorrelationMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        CORR(readability_score, engagement_rate) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_readability_score,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    AverageMetrics am
JOIN 
    CorrelationMetrics cm ON am.article_category = cm.article_category
CROSS JOIN 
    ComplexityCounts cc
GROUP BY 
    am.article_category, am.avg_readability_score, am.avg_engagement_rate, cm.correlation_coefficient, cc.article_count;

WITH SessionMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS session_id,
        AVG(i.seqval) AS avg_seq_value
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.seshlink2
),
BounceAdjustments AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey AS session_id,
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS bounce_adjustment
    FROM 
        sessions s
),
SessionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.session_id,
        ba.bounce_adjustment,
        sm.avg_seq_value AS avg_seq_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN ba.bounce_adjustment = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE sm.avg_seq_value / ba.bounce_adjustment 
        END AS efficiency_score
    FROM 
        SessionMetrics sm
    JOIN 
        BounceAdjustments ba ON sm.session_id = ba.session_id
)
SELECT 
    se.session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    s.bncrate AS bounce_impact,
    se.avg_seq_value,
    se.efficiency_score
FROM 
    SessionEfficiency se
JOIN 
    sessions s ON se.session_id = s.seshkey
ORDER BY 
    se.session_id;

WITH SessionMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS session_id,
        AVG(i.seqval) AS avg_seqval
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.seshlink2
),
BounceAdjustment AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey AS session_id,
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS sbra
    FROM 
        sessions s
),
SessionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.session_id,
        sm.avg_seqval AS cie,
        ba.sbra,
        CASE 
            WHEN ba.sbra = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE sm.avg_seqval / ba.sbra 
        END AS rtse
    FROM 
        SessionMetrics sm
    JOIN 
        BounceAdjustment ba ON sm.session_id = ba.session_id
)
SELECT 
    s.seshkey AS session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    s.bncrate AS bounce_impact,
    sm.avg_seqval AS avg_sequence_value,
    se.rtse AS efficiency_score
FROM 
    sessions s
JOIN 
    SessionEfficiency se ON s.seshkey = se.session_id
JOIN
    SessionMetrics sm ON s.seshkey = sm.session_id;

WITH UserMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        u.typelabel AS subscription_type,
        u.seglabel AS demographic_segment,
        u.ageval AS age,
        u.gendlbl AS gender,
        u.occulbl AS occupation,
        u.testgrp AS ab_test_group,
        (u.subdays * 0.1) + (u.ageval * 0.2) + 
        CASE u.gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.3 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.2 
        END + 
        CASE u.occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.15 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_subscription_value,
        (u.ageval * 0.3) + 
        CASE u.gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.2 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.15 
        END + 
        CASE u.occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.1 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_demographic_score,
        u.user_preferences ->> 'interests' AS interests
    FROM users u
),
GroupedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        subscription_type,
        demographic_segment,
        AVG(user_subscription_value) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(user_demographic_score) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment
)
SELECT 
    gm.subscription_type,
    gm.demographic_segment,
    gm.avg_usv,
    gm.avg_uds,
    STRING_AGG(um.interests, ', ' ORDER BY um.interests) AS shared_interests,
    gm.user_count
FROM GroupedMetrics gm
JOIN UserMetrics um ON gm.subscription_type = um.subscription_type AND gm.demographic_segment = um.demographic_segment
GROUP BY gm.subscription_type, gm.demographic_segment, gm.avg_usv, gm.avg_uds, gm.user_count
ORDER BY gm.user_count DESC, gm.avg_uds DESC;

WITH article_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.catlabel AS article_category,
        t1.difflevel AS complexity_level,
        -- Calculate ARS using the formula provided
        (
            t1.readsec * LOG(t1.wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS ars,
        -- Extract engagement rate from the JSONB column
        (t1.engagement_metrics->>'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles AS t1
),
average_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(ars) AS avg_ars,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
),
complexity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        am.article_category,
        CORR(am.ars, am.engagement_rate) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM 
        article_metrics AS am
    GROUP BY 
        am.article_category
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_ars,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.complexity_level,
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    average_metrics AS am
JOIN 
    correlation_metrics AS cm ON am.article_category = cm.article_category
JOIN 
    complexity_counts AS cc ON am.article_category = cc.article_category
ORDER BY 
    am.article_category;

WITH cie AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS seshkey, 
        AVG(i.seqval) OVER (PARTITION BY i.seshlink2) AS avg_seqval
    FROM interactions AS i
),
sbra AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey, 
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval/100) AS bounce_impact
    FROM sessions AS s
)
SELECT 
    s.seshkey AS session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    sb.bounce_impact,
    ci.avg_seqval AS avg_seq_value,
    ci.avg_seqval / sb.bounce_impact AS rtse
FROM sessions AS s
JOIN cie AS ci ON s.seshkey = ci.seshkey
JOIN sbra AS sb ON s.seshkey = sb.seshkey
WHERE sb.bounce_impact != 0;

WITH daily_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(seshstart) AS session_date, 
        AVG(engscore) AS daily_avg_uer
    FROM 
        sessions
    GROUP BY 
        session_date
)

    d.daily_avg_uer
FROM 
    sessions s

    s.engscore > d.daily_avg_uer

        (seshviews * engscore) / seshdur AS calculated_uer
    FROM 
        sessions
),

WITH readability_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        catlabel AS article_category,
        difflevel::TEXT AS complexity_level,
        (
            readsec * LOG(wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN difflevel::TEXT ILIKE 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN difflevel::TEXT ILIKE 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN difflevel::TEXT ILIKE 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS readability_score,
        (engagement_metrics ->> 'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles
),
average_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        readability_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        CORR(avg_readability_score, avg_engagement_rate) AS correlation_score
    FROM 
        average_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
)
SELECT 
    a.article_category,
    a.complexity_level,
    a.avg_readability_score,
    a.avg_engagement_rate,
    c.correlation_score,
    a.article_count
FROM 
    average_scores a
JOIN 
    correlation_scores c ON a.article_category = c.article_category;

WITH sbra_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        u.typelabel AS user_type,
        u.seglabel AS user_segment,
        a.catlabel AS performance_category,
        (s.bncrate * (1 - (s.ctrval / 100))) AS sbra
    FROM 
        users u
    JOIN 
        sessions s ON u.userkey = s.userel
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON s.seshkey = i.seshlink2
    JOIN 
        articles a ON i.artval = a.artkey
)
SELECT 
    user_type, user_segment, performance_category, AVG(sbra) as avg_sbra
FROM 
    sbra_calc
GROUP BY 
    user_type, user_segment, performance_category
HAVING 
    COUNT(user_segment) > 10;

        u.seglabel AS user_segment, 
        a.catlabel AS performance_category, 
        (s.bncrate * (1 - (s.ctrval / 100))) AS sbra
    FROM 
        users u
    JOIN 
        sessions s ON u.userkey = s.userel
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON s.seshkey = i.seshlink2
    JOIN 
        articles a ON i.artval = a.artkey
)
SELECT 
    user_type, 
    user_segment, 
    performance_category, 
    AVG(sbra) AS avg_sbra, 
    COUNT(sbra) AS session_count
FROM 
    sbra_calc
GROUP BY 
    user_type, 
    user_segment, 
    performance_category
HAVING 
    COUNT(sbra) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    user_type, 
    user_segment, 
    performance_category;

WITH uer_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        seshstart,
        (seshviews * engscore / seshdur) AS uer
    FROM 
        sessions
),
daily_avg_uer AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(seshstart) AS session_date,
        AVG(uer) AS avg_uer
    FROM 
        uer_calc
    GROUP BY 
        session_date
)
SELECT 
    uer_calc.seshstart AS session_date,
    uer_calc.uer AS calculated_uer,
    daily_avg_uer.avg_uer AS daily_avg_uer
FROM 
    uer_calc
JOIN 
    daily_avg_uer ON DATE(uer_calc.seshstart) = daily_avg_uer.session_date
WHERE 
    uer_calc.uer > daily_avg_uer.avg_uer
ORDER BY 
    uer_calc.seshstart;

WITH user_demo AS (
    SELECT 
        substatus AS subscription_status,
        (user_preferences->>'interests')::text AS shared_interests,
        (user_preferences->>'activity_level')::text AS activity_level,
        (user_preferences->>'satisfaction_score')::decimal AS satisfaction_score,
        ageval AS age,
        gendlbl AS gender,
        occulbl AS occupation
    FROM users
),
user_scores AS (
    SELECT
        ud.subscription_status,
        ud.shared_interests,
        ud.activity_level,
        ud.satisfaction_score,
        ud.age,
        ud.gender,
        ud.occupation,
        u.subdays * 
            CASE u.substatus
                WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1
            END AS usv,
        u.ageval * 
            CASE u.gendlbl
                WHEN 'M' THEN 1.2
                WHEN 'F' THEN 1.5
                ELSE 1
            END * 
            CASE u.occulbl
                WHEN 'Professional' THEN 1.3
                WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1
            END AS uds
    FROM user_demo AS ud
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.substatus = ud.subscription_status
),
grouped_users AS (
    SELECT
        subscription_status,
        shared_interests,
        activity_level,
        satisfaction_score,
        age,
        gender,
        occupation,
        AVG(usv) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(uds) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count,
        STRING_AGG(shared_interests, ',') AS aggregated_interests
    FROM user_scores
    GROUP BY subscription_status, shared_interests, activity_level, satisfaction_score, age, gender, occupation
)
SELECT
    subscription_status,
    shared_interests,
    activity_level,
    satisfaction_score,
    age,
    gender,
    occupation,
    avg_usv,
    avg_uds,
    aggregated_interests
FROM grouped_users
WHERE user_count > 10
ORDER BY avg_uds DESC;

WITH user_interaction_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        userel AS user_id,
        SUM(seshclicks) AS total_clicks,
        SUM(seshviews) AS total_views,
        AVG(engscore) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(seshclicks) + SUM(seshviews) + AVG(engscore) AS custom_interaction_score
    FROM 
        sessions
    GROUP BY 
        userel
),
ranked_users AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        total_clicks,
        total_views,
        avg_engagement_score,
        custom_interaction_score,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY custom_interaction_score DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        user_interaction_scores
)
SELECT 
    user_id,
    total_clicks,
    total_views,
    avg_engagement_score,
    custom_interaction_score
FROM 
    ranked_users
ORDER BY 
    rank
LIMIT 10;

WITH usv_uds AS (
    SELECT 
        substatus, 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN substatus = 'Premium' THEN 1.5
                WHEN substatus = 'Enterprise' THEN 1.2
                WHEN substatus = 'Basic' THEN 1.0
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * subdays AS usv,
        ageval * 1.1 * 1.3 AS uds,
        user_preferences
    FROM users
)
SELECT 
    usv,
    uds,
    (user_preferences ->> 'interests') AS interests
FROM usv_uds
LIMIT 10;
